name: repo-hygiene
description: Audit routine Git hygiene, deep topology, and regressions with exact recovery boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect Git cleanup and recovery safely.
interface.longDescription: Three Codex skills distinguish routine local housekeeping from explicit deep topology/recovery audits and Git-based regression diagnosis, with exact targets and verified postconditions.
capabilities: Deep Git topology and recovery audits
defaultPrompt: Use $repo-hygiene:routine to inspect local cleanup candidates.
Use $repo-hygiene:deep to audit refs, worktrees, and recovery before a Git cleanup.
Use $repo-hygiene:debug to locate the commit behind this reproducible regression.
